# Exploratory Analysis and Visualisation

> Answer a director's questions from her own data: written questions first, charts that do not mislead, patterns checked against chance, and a report that reruns from raw data. SDAIA Academy course DS-203, version 2027.2.0, in English.

Each slide is a heading such as "#### [day1#slide-id] Title": cite slides by that id, and each citation is a link (slides/day1.html#slide-id). These files are what a trainee sees: no speaker notes and no answer keys.

## Course

- [Course page](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-203/index.md): overview, outcomes, schedule and labs; the page itself is https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-203/index.html
- [The whole course](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-203/llms-full.txt): every unit, session and slide in one file, about 23,677 tokens
- [Practice questions](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-203/practice.html): questions to check yourself, with feedback after each answer

## Slides

- [Day 1: Questions and first looks](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-203/slides/day1.md): Before any chart: what is asked, what one row is, what the values look like and which summary describes them; sessions: Write the questions first, Profiling a table, Distributions, Summaries that fit the shape; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-203/slides/day1.html; about 5,918 tokens
- [Day 2: Relationships and time](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-203/slides/day2.md): Two variables together, counts against rates, change over time, and a total that says the opposite of its parts; sessions: Two variables at once, Counts, rates and denominators, Change over time, When the total reverses; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-203/slides/day2.html; about 5,476 tokens
- [Day 3: Building honest charts](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-203/slides/day3.md): A chart as a specification: marks, encodings and scales chosen so that the picture and the numbers agree; sessions: Marks, encodings and scales, Small multiples, Charts that mislead, Colour, labels and Arabic text; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-203/slides/day3.html; about 4,942 tokens
- [Day 4: Check and report](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-203/slides/day4.md): Which patterns survive a chance check, how to draw what is not known, and a report that anyone can run again; sessions: Could it be chance, Showing uncertainty, The traps of exploring, A report that reruns; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-203/slides/day4.html; about 5,722 tokens
- [Capstone: Capstone: the exploratory report and its defence](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-203/slides/capstone.md): Each participant defends an exploratory report on an unseen dataset in eight minutes, and redraws one chart on request; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-203/slides/capstone.html; about 1,063 tokens

## Labs

- [Lab 1.1: Five questions from the brief](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-203/labs/D1_1_brief_questions.ipynb): Day 1, Session 1, 25 min
- [Lab 1.2: Profile the stay register](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-203/labs/D1_2_profile_stays.ipynb): Day 1, Session 2, 25 min
- [Lab 1.3: Length of stay by origin](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-203/labs/D1_3_length_of_stay.ipynb): Day 1, Session 3, 25 min
- [Lab 1.4: Centre and spread for four variables](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-203/labs/D1_4_centre_spread.ipynb): Day 1, Session 4, 25 min
- [Lab 2.1: Occupancy against ticket sales](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-203/labs/D2_1_occupancy_tickets.ipynb): Day 2, Session 1, 25 min
- [Lab 2.2: Complaint rates and small cells](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-203/labs/D2_2_complaint_rates.ipynb): Day 2, Session 2, 25 min
- [Lab 2.3: Monthly arrivals, season and festivals](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-203/labs/D2_3_monthly_arrivals.ipynb): Day 2, Session 3, 25 min
- [Lab 2.4: The satisfaction reversal](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-203/labs/D2_4_satisfaction_reversal.ipynb): Day 2, Session 4, 25 min
- [Lab 3.1: A chart from a written specification](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-203/labs/D3_1_chart_from_spec.ipynb): Day 3, Session 1, 25 min
- [Lab 3.2: Arrivals in small multiples](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-203/labs/D3_2_facet_arrivals.ipynb): Day 3, Session 2, 25 min
- [Lab 3.3: Repair six misleading charts](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-203/labs/D3_3_repair_six_charts.ipynb): Day 3, Session 3, 25 min
- [Lab 3.4: One chart, two languages, safe colours](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-203/labs/D3_4_bilingual_chart.ipynb): Day 3, Session 4, 25 min
- [Lab 4.1: Chance checks on two patterns](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-203/labs/D4_1_chance_checks.ipynb): Day 4, Session 1, 25 min
- [Lab 4.2: Intervals on the satisfaction chart](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-203/labs/D4_2_intervals_caption.ipynb): Day 4, Session 2, 25 min
- [Lab 4.3: Count the comparisons](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-203/labs/D4_3_count_comparisons.ipynb): Day 4, Session 3, 25 min
- [Lab 4.4: A report that reruns](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-203/labs/D4_4_report_reruns.ipynb): Day 4, Session 4, 25 min
